summary.text: Chris Toney, listed by Ballotpedia as Christopher Toney, is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 43, where he has served since 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked as a school bus operator.

paragraphs.text: Chris Toney graduated from Liberty High School, earned an A.A. in applied science from New River Community and Technical College and a B.A. in special education and teaching from Concord University.
His career experience includes working as a school bus operator, and he has served on the board of directors of the Raleigh County Community Action Association.
Toney's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session were Education (vice-chair), Finance, Health and Human Resources Accountability, Jails and Prisons, and Senior, Children, and Family Issues.
